card.name: Start of 'substitutable' and 'dispensed'
card.fires_on: The first piece of the words 'substitutable', 'substituted' and 'dispensed' (Sub-stit, disp), right after 'not', 'be' or 'is' in label restrictions.

modes.label: Substitution warnings
modes.description: Piece 'stit' or 'substit' at the start of 'substitutable' or 'substituted' in statements that products are not interchangeable.
modes.example: Two Amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium 250 mg/125 mg Tablets are NOT Sub<<stit>>utable with One 500 mg

modes.label: Dispensing rules
modes.description: Piece 'disp' at the start of 'dispensed' after 'is' or 'be' in pharmacy handling rules.
modes.example: importance of reading the Medication Guide that they will receive from their pharmacist every time an opioid analgesic is<< disp>>ensed to them.

card.writes: Little clear meaning; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of 'substitutable' or 'dispensed' in label rules about swapping or handing out a drug.
